text:
cara: Hi team — dropping Zephyr Health RFI + capability matrix. Need SE/ProdSec/Legal eyes before we hand to procurement tomorrow morning. Attached: zephyr_rfi_v3.pdf, zephyr_capmatrix.xlsx, zephyr_security_qs.xlsx

vik: scanning. Two quick asks from buyer: 1) they want a one-week POC with 400 concurrent embed calls during peak windows; 2) they need a clear cost table for Hosted vs Dedicated.

cara: I added both options in the capmatrix and a basic POC pricing tab. Recommend Hosted trial with a 1-week reserved burst unless they insist on tenant isolation.

omri: SE suggestion for POC plan: 2d setup/verify, 5d steady-state, 2d peak. Include a small perf harness and synthetic dataset. I'll add `zephyr_benchmark.md`. Quick infra snippet for smoke test:
```
# smoke test
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/embed \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $POC_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1b","input":"clinical note sample"}'
```

nidhi: Security review: draft missing KMS/HSM integration text, explicit data residency line, log retention for POC, and SOC2/ISO links. Please fill Q24-Q29 in security sheet. Also confirm whether any raw data will transit our account during ingest.

cara: We'll state: customer-managed collector writes to their S3 in the customer's account; we don't stage raw PII in our environment. I'll make that explicit in Q25.

vik: Pricing nuance: embeddings billed per 1k units. With their expected pattern I added a 20% conservative buffer in the pricing tab. Also added a small pre-POC kickoff recommendation to align dataset masking.

omri: I'll attach a minimal harness and synthetic data link in the benchmark file. SE signoff pending one quick perf run.

legal: I'll review liability and data terms. Two asks: 1) tighten the POC liability cap to standard exceptions, 2) include a DPA link in the RFI. Will upload redlines by 10:30 PT.

files-bot: Uploaded zephyr_rfi_v3.pdf (2.0 MB), zephyr_capmatrix.xlsx (46 KB), zephyr_security_qs.xlsx (30 KB), zephyr_benchmark.md (3 KB)

nidhi: ProdSec quick pass: update Q26 with KMS phrasing and add HSM timeline note — Private + customer HSM adds ~3 weeks. Also add explicit EU residency line if buyer is EU.

legal: Uploaded zephyr_legal_redlines.docx. Added DPA stub and tightened liability language.

cara: Final checklist: SE run + signoff, ProdSec KMS phrasing update, Legal redlines incorporated. Ping here when done. :thumbsup:

omri: SE signoff done after a short perf run — harness looks good.

nidhi: ProdSec signoff done after KMS phrasing update. Uploaded updated security sheet.

vik: I merged conservative/optimistic cost rows and added a short note about quota bump time (48-72 hrs for hosted bursts).

cara: All set — sending to Zephyr procurement now. Thanks everyone. cc @zephyr-ops (external) :rocket:
